items.title: Stock Futures Rise as Oil Prices Dip After AI Selloff
items.summary: Stocks looked set to struggle for direction on Friday as a drop in oil prices eased fears about higher inflation, even as artificial-intelligence jitters lingered.  Nasdaq 100 futures rose 0.1%.  The Dow was on track to outperform the other two major indexes because it tends to be more reactive to oil prices, which were retreating having spiked above $100 a barrel the previous session.

items.title: Sandisk (SNDK) Stock Gains Attention As Memory Chip Stocks Rally In Tech Sell Off
items.summary: Sandisk (NasdaqGS:SNDK) attracted attention as memory chip stocks rose during a sharp tech sell off. The move came on a trading day when leading tech stocks saw their weakest single day performance since April 2025. The divergence between memory chip stocks and larger tech peers highlighted changing sector preferences among investors. Sandisk, known for its flash memory and storage products, sat in the spotlight as traders looked more closely at memory and AI linked semiconductor stocks...
